text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While headed back to the academy after an outing with Agnes Tachyon…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, well, Yukino. You seem to really be pushing it, eh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Tachyon… Um, yeah… Haaah…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Truth is… Right now, I'm try'n t'get a smaller waist…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Your waist?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well… I wanna change my appearance t'look more like a city girl…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I thought if I wanted to tone up my body, runn'n would be the best way.
choice_data_list: I'm sure there's other ways too…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-but, I just don't know how…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. In that case, maybe I can give you a hand!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I've just the right prototype for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, golly! You mean it?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Zounds! Thanks a million, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, early in the morning when no one is around, Agnes Tachyon calls me to the back of the school.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I call it, "Body Modification as You Wish!" It's a prototype, but I hope you treat it with care.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh! I don't really get it, but it seems super high-tech!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A strange chair, likely to be confiscated immediately if found, sits in the shade…
choice_data_list: Are you sure this is okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's what we're about to find out. I'm counting on you, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You sure it's okay I'm the first to try it? Gee willikers… guess I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do I just sit in it like this? What's gonna happen next?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's for you to find out once you've sat down! Now, let's start this ex—I mean, tighten up that waist!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how you look at it, this won't end well! I can't stand by and say nothing.
choice_data_list: Let me sit down in it first!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the problem, Trainer? You're blocking her way to the seat.
choice_data_list: Let's try the trendy way to get in shape!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The trendy way?! Is there a new city trend?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you saying it's more effective than my chair?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In that case, we should compare!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Since this was your idea, I'll have you be our test subject.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That trendy way to get in shape or my "Body Modification as You Wish"…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's time to discover which is better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Yukino Bijin about the trendy way to get in shape and keep her from sitting in the chair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon hears this and…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mmm… if that's the case, I can incorporate those movements and improve the flow of electricity…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… a wonderful idea! This is bound to become an interesting experiment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without fail, a few days later, she uses me as her test subject for the improved "Body Modification as You Wish."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh… Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment I sit in the chair, I feel an intense surge of electricity running throughout my body!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ohh, yes, yes, yes! The electrical current runs through your body breaking down fat on contact! This design will prove revolutionary in—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainer? There's something funny with your hair…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! It's all stand'n on end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh… your body is also emitting electricity, so much that we can't get any closer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: How absolutely fascinating! I see, I see, so this is the result!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon smiles happily… although the experiment appears to be a failure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've suffered no injuries, but I'm affected by a constant buildup of static electricity for some time after.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin decides to go on a steady diet, while Agnes Tachyon…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Has become all the more eager to improve her new creation.
